summary: Brushed DC planetary gear motor with a cylindrical body, a round gearbox housing at the output end, and an 8mm REX output shaft that projects 24mm. The encoder housing is at the rear. Only the shaft diameter (8mm) and shaft length (24mm) are stated, so the overall body size is an estimate.

mountingSurfaces.description: Output-end face of the gearbox housing, where the 8mm REX shaft exits. The shaft projects 24mm beyond this face to z=+50.
Rear end face at the encoder cap, with the encoder connector. It is not intended for mounting.

notes: The images and specs give no overall length or body diameter. The 37mm diameter and 100mm total length (including the 24mm shaft) are rough estimates and should be checked against the vendor drawing. The shaft axis is along z, centered in x and y. Mounting hole positions on the gearbox face are not legible in the images, so no holes are listed. The images also show flat sides on the motor jacket, but their dimensions are not given.
